scope: All 35 keys of ui.teamBridgeTrial on PR #1654 head 5433ed80aac2f6807264d5a64a07b7a61cf75418: meaning vs en + context.json, register (locale style guide), glossary terms, placeholders ({date} only; no plural/select arms), the no-card / nothing-charged-automatically / end-date / pause-until-subscribe clauses, RTL bidi controls, and {date} rendered through formatTrialDate's Intl options (node 24.22.1).

findings.problem: 18 of 35 values put a space between Chinese and Latin/digit/{date} runs ('免费试用 Teams 30 天', '试用有效期至 {date}'). The zh-CN style guide says no space is inserted (width discipline), and the sibling ui.teamBridge namespace has 0 such spaces in 371 values (measured).
findings.fix: Drop those spaces, e.g. '免费试用Teams 30天' → '免费试用Teams30天'; '试用有效期至{date}'; '开始30天免费Team试用'.

findings.problem: '成员可共用的共享额度' says 'shared' twice (共用 + 共享).
findings.fix: '成员可共用的额度池' or '成员共用的额度'.
